answer: Give every newcomer one jade token that can only be spent by publishing a reasoned dissent to a popular proposal at dawn of a new season, when an ember of debate still glows. Strangers grade each dissent blind: does it name a real risk, offer evidence, and propose a fix? Echoes of the crowd earn nothing, and a dissent that survives scrutiny and changes a decision earns standing. A farm of fakes cannot mass-produce distinct, sharp disagreements, because each one needs a fresh argument, real evidence, and a stranger's honest grade, so cloning stops paying.
